newsitem.title: JAPAN: Queensland Treasury Corp launches yen/A$ samurais.
newsitem.headline: Queensland Treasury Corp launches yen/A$ samurais.

text.p: Australia's Queensland Treasury Corp (QTC) on Friday launched 30 billion yen worth of 5.5 percent yen/Australian dollar dual currency samurai bonds due on October 15, 1998, lead-manager Nomura Securities said.
The bonds are priced at par and are guaranteed by the state of Queensland.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows.
AMT 30 bln yen COUPON 5.5 pct MATURITY Oct 15, 1998
TYPE yen/A$ samurai ISS PRICE 100 yen PAY DATE Oct 15, 1996
SUB PERIOD Oct 2 to 14 INTEREST PAYMENT April 15 and Oct 15
SIGN DATE Oct 1 LAST RATING AA(S&P), AA2(Moody's)
LEAD MANAGER Nomura Securities LEAD TRUSTEE Fuji Bank

NOTES: The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in Australian dollars. Holders of the samurai bonds will receive A$5,691.51 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity. Syndicate members are Nomura, Daiwa, Yamaichi, Nikko and Kokusai.
